testResults.name: lakeclient-contract
testResults.result: 9 tests passed for authenticated ensure, polling, API errors, file responses, DuckDB reads, and the local AAPL NBBO spread flow.

testResults.name: aapl-nbbo-acceptance
testResults.result: The local mocked API flow ensures one quote day, polls to completion, reads the API-issued Parquet URL, and computes an exact 0.020000000000000000 NBBO spread.

testResults.name: focused-quality
testResults.result: Focused Ruff lint, Ruff format, and ty checks passed; lakeclient imports no Alpaca, Azure, or lake service implementation.

decisions: lakeclient is the standalone consumer SDK used by the future harness lake adapter.
It consumes API-issued URLs and does not construct provider or Azure credentials.
